mostWorthwhile.text: Finishing the window bench was most worthwhile: its worktop and padded seat become a specific place to watch sunset, making the construction feel lived in.

leastWorthwhile.text: Forming and lining the troughs felt a little perfunctory; both were clear but the results offered little detail about how they work.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the bench to combine a worktop with a padded end for sitting, so the description clarified the arrangement.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary: each material and tool had an understandable purpose, although the paving blocks becoming a bench surface was a bit of a guess.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue, especially to see what grows and how the home develops; the bench's personal detail made that prospect appealing, though the trough sequence was quite mechanical.
